title: Connect from traces
subtitle: Point your OpenTelemetry exporter at Heimdall. When the first traces arrive, Heimdall proposes the agent they show.

endpoint.title: 1. Send traces
endpoint.description: Any OpenTelemetry SDK, OpenInference, OpenLLMetry or Logfire works. Only what is needed to find your agent is kept: names, models, tools called, routes. Never prompts, answers or tool arguments.
endpoint.tokenShown: Copy this token now. It is shown once and is already filled in below.
endpoint.tokenNeedsAdmin: An org admin creates ingest tokens.

waiting.title: 2. Waiting for the first trace
waiting.description: This page checks every few seconds. Run your agent once with the settings above.
waiting.orFile: Or infer from an OTLP export file (JSON or protobuf). Nothing is kept.

draft.title: 2. What your traces show
draft.fromFile: From the file you picked (not kept)
draft.yamlHint: Commit it as .heimdall/agent.yaml; the CLI reads it: heimdall agent file push

connect.title: 3. Connect this agent
connect.description: The connect test then proves it: Heimdall sends a real request and checks the answer.
connect.name: Agent name
connect.secretHint: Name of a secret in Settings > Secrets. Traces never carry auth headers.
connect.wrapHint: No serving route in your traces. Open Wrap my existing app to give the repository and start command.
connect.incomplete: Give a valid name and an http or https URL.

entryHint: Already sending OpenTelemetry traces? Let Heimdall propose the agent.
